title: DOW-UAP-D100, Air Materiel Command Report on Unidentified Flying Objects, 1947-1948
doc_notes: This document is a collection of Air Materiel Command and Air Force correspondence regarding Project SIGN and the investigation of unidentified aerial phenomena, containing several specific encounter reports.

encounters.summary: Witnesses observed two objects falling to earth from an unknown source, described as falling aircraft with smoke and debris trails.
Witness observed two objects falling to earth, one appearing to be on fire with red and black smoke.
Pilot observed a yellow sphere, 25-40 feet in diameter, moving at constant altitude.
encounters.location_name: Anacostia Naval Air Station, Washington D.C.
